description.value: Eighties Restaurant is a North Shore landmark that has been serving all-day breakfast and classic diner fare from its North Vancouver location since the 1980s. Helmed by Red Seal chef and James Beard participant Noel Scott — whose training spans Italy, Portugal, and Morocco — the diner is consistently voted the North Shore's top breakfast venue. The cozy space also includes The Green Room, a private section seating up to 50 with a full bar, and the kitchen caters events for up to 100 guests.
